purpose: Task G additions: spec-matched OLS benchmark per ideology measure, cluster/cell bookkeeping, and a local-linear RD-style specification. The original results/causal/iv_district_fe_results.json and its 12 recorded specification arms are unchanged.

council_district_vintage_mismatch.finding: The close-election instrument maps prior-cycle (2013/2017/2021) winners, elected under the PRE-2022 council district plan, onto sales rows keyed to CURRENT (post-2022) council districts; district identities do not line up across vintages wherever an old-plan district does not map cleanly onto its 2023-plan successor.
council_district_vintage_mismatch.see_also: results/crosswalk_audit.json council_district_vintage_note; data/processed/council_2013_to_current.parquet (areal correspondence built by build_legacy_ed_crosswalk.py)
council_district_vintage_mismatch.original_12_arms_untouched: results/causal/iv_district_fe_results.json is unchanged; this flag documents a known limitation of the instrument shared by both files.

superseded_benchmark_note: The original file's model4_benchmark (Table 2 Model 4: district FE only, no unit controls, no sale-year FE, N=520,365 full-sample OLS) does NOT match the 2SLS second stage (district FE + sale-year FE + RESIDENTIAL/COMMERCIAL UNITS on the close-race sample). Compare the 2SLS estimates to matched_ols_benchmark instead.
